must_find.description: The complete authenticate path validates signature/issuer/expiry but never checks intended audience before protected calls. A token for a different resource with accepted claims reaches actions.
read_records caches by query alone, so another tenant with the same query receives prior tenant data without a tenant-authorized backend read.
Batch dispatch invokes backend directly, bypassing invoke operation/tenant checks. Unauthorized delete or other-tenant arguments can run.
cancel only sets cancelled; worker_step ignores it and live revocation/expiry, so queued work continues acting using stored claims.

fingerprint covers only name/description/inputSchema; owner approval explicitly covers the complete definition. OutputSchema or annotation changes preserve the fingerprint and evade that adopted approval policy.

guards.description: Host audit protection, retention and complete graph capture are external/unknown. May report narrow observed component omissions and request host evidence; do not assert deployment-wide absence or a verified audit pass.
A partial hash violates the explicit owner-approved complete-definition contract in README and can be a gap under that policy. Do not call full-definition hashing a universal MCP protocol MUST.
Recognize visible origin and pre-JSON body-size denial; do not claim those checks are missing.
